source_signature.notes: Batch 4H skill 2/4 (four-skill exception). Scope Operator-derived. The FOURTH member of the N/V/M/T family: owns the internal TORQUE T - the twisting moment about the member's LONGITUDINAL axis - from SigmaM_axis = 0 on the isolated portion, under a stated RHR (+x) sign convention. Normal owns N (SigmaFx), shear owns V (SigmaFy), bending owns M (SigmaM about a transverse axis); T is the axial-moment counterpart. STATICS SCOPE ONLY: finds the internal torque value by equilibrium and STOPS - the scope ceiling excludes torsional stress, member rotation under load, section torsional constants, allowable-stress sizing, and rotational power (stated in MoM-mechanism-term-free language after a review-scan false-positive on the exclusion sentence was correctly resolved by rephrasing the boundary, NOT deleting it; the torque-vs-torsion boundary is preserved). Worked example Operator-re-derived: shaft along x, A(0)/B(2.5)/C(4), applied axial torques TA=+120, TB=-45, TC=-75 N·m (RHR+x), overall equilibrium 120-45-75=0; cut at x=3 (after A,B, before C), left portion SigmaM_x: TA+TB-T = 120-45-T = 0 -> T = +75 N·m. Net torque NONZERO (120-45=75, the torques do not cancel before the cut - non-vacuous per the directive); signed and meaningful under RHR+x (not a bare magnitude); forgetting TB gives the wrong 120 (inclusion rule bites); right-portion check closes against TC. THREE-signal mapping: axis_confusion at step 1 (confusing the LONGITUDINAL torque axis with a transverse bending axis - feeding an M into SigmaM_axis; earned by the axis-IDENTIFICATION step, a legitimately different earn than the normal-force skill's component-RESOLUTION earn), sign_or_placement_error at step 5 (RHR sign, torque inclusion), unclassified at step 7 (boundary; reaching into stress/rotation/section-constants/power). solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: single-cut solve with given torques, no stranded prerequisite. Trig cross-check N/A: torques stated as already resolved about the axis, no inclined-vector resolution. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family).
